messages:
Nina: quick report from pairing with a customer on onboarding: their vite+rollup hybrid app hits a weird auth retry after we bundle the SDK. First request OK, refresh triggers, then 401 loop.
Theo: interesting. does the bundle include CJS artifacts?
Nina: yes. build output shows sdk resolved to dist/cjs/index.js even though package.json has module too. No exports field.
Rohit: that smells like bundler resolve order or an optimizer conversion. Which plugins?
Nina: rollup with commonjs plugin + vite build. Also using tsup in a shared lib. Local workaround was aliasing the ESM entry, but that's not scalable.
Theo: can you paste the tiny repro snippet?
Nina: 
```
import SDK from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const c = new SDK({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
export default async (req) => new Response(JSON.stringify(await c.generate({ prompt: 'x' })));
```
The runtime error: `TypeError: attachAuthHeader is not a function` from the auth wrapper. Debug shows the auth util ended up as a namespace object w/o default callable.
Rohit: two fixes: 1) add a package.json "exports" map with import/require aliases so bundlers pick the right file; 2) publish typings that explicitly export default and named exports (avoid `export =`).
Theo: also add a small CI smoke that runs resolve-package-path across webpack/vite/rollup to assert the resolved file is the ESM build for module consumers.
Nina: adding an example repo `examples/vite-rollup-edge-auth-repro` with minimal build scripts and README showing the alias workarounds.
CI Bot: created issue #1309 and added failing sampleapp pipeline; build step 6123 shows deterministic failure.
Rohit: I'll draft the exports+types PR. Also confirm tree-shaking: ensure auth util is a named export in ESM so `import { attachAuthHeader }` always exists.
Theo: doc note: "Edge runtimes + bundlers: prefer module-first resolution or ensure SDK exports map; if you see auth retry loops, inspect resolved entry in your build output."
Nina: thanks. I'll post the repro link in the issue and ping support.
